samples.summary: Tautological branch in a loop assertion
samples.evidence: `expect(typeof value === 'number' ? Number.isFinite(value) : true).toBe(true)` asserts `true === true` for every non-numeric style value (e.g. `alignment`), so the loop only meaningfully checks the numeric fields. finding.summary: The docs slim toolbar's color-reset change (`""` → `undefined`) — the exact wiring issue #728 is about — ships with no test; only the sibling `TextFormatGroup` got one.
finding.evidence: The new UI regression test `packages/frontend/tests/components/text-formatting/color-reset.test.ts` renders only `TextFormatGroup`. `docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx` contains its own `handleTextColor` / `handleHighlightColor` and its own `onReset={() => handleTextColor(undefined)}` (lines ~402, 490, 512) and there is no test file for it: `Glob packages/frontend/tests/**/*formatting-toolbar*` returns nothing, and grepping `.test.*` files for `docs-formatting-toolbar` finds no match. A regression re-introducing `""` in this component would be caught by nothing.

verdict.reason: The finding claims the docs slim toolbar's color-reset change ships with no test and that only TextFormatGroup got one. This is false: the same file the reviewer read, packages/frontend/tests/components/text-formatting/color-reset.test.ts, contains a SECOND describe block at lines 152-173 ("DocsFormattingToolbar header/footer color reset (issue #728)") that imports DocsFormattingToolbar at line 20 and renders it at lines 156 and 164 for both editContext values ("header" and "footer"). The reviewer evidently stopped reading at line 127, where the TextFormatGroup block ends; lines 129-135 explicitly document that the header/footer toolbar is a separate call site needing its own coverage. The reviewer's specific claim that grepping .test.* files for "docs-formatting-toolbar" finds no match is directly contradicted by line 20. The test is meaningful, not vacuous: it clicks the real trigger (ColorSwatchButton maps label -> aria-label, color-swatch-button.tsx:37) and the real reset control (data-none-control with onClick={onReset}, color-picker-grid.tsx:34-37), exercising the exact wiring at docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:490 and :512 that the finding cites. The helper expectClearedOnly (lines 103-113) deliberately avoids the weak toHaveBeenCalledWith({key: undefined}) form and asserts hasOwnProperty, the exact key set, and that the value is undefined — so a regression re-introducing "" would make style[key] an empty string and fail line 112. The editor is mocked but the component under test is not mocked away.
